purpose: Outcome-agnostic formal comparison of the frozen raw-DNA mathematical discovery layer against protein-first and conventional repeat-first baselines.
primary_endpoints: truth-locus recovered under frozen candidate definition
fraction of genome exposed by RT-first neighborhoods
primary_statistics: paired descriptive metrics; exact paired sign/Wilcoxon only after score freeze; bootstrap CIs; no asymptotic claims from tiny n
interpretation_boundary: This benchmark tests discovery/localization behavior and annotation dependence. It is not an assay of ART biochemical function.
implementation_hotfix: R1 source/runtime fixes plus schema-aware long/wide proposal-family parsing and truth-blind overlap-only RT-locus collapse before ranking; no scientific thresholds or endpoints changed.
